create_quantile_regressor: create a QuantileRegressor to predict conditional quantiles on heteroscedastic or asymmetric distributed targets
fit_quantile_regressor: fit a QuantileRegressor model on synthetic data with specified quantile and regularization parameters
compare_quantile_linear_regression: compare QuantileRegressor and LinearRegression training and cross-validated MAE and MSE on asymmetric data
cross_validate_model: cross-validate a scikit-learn regressor using mean absolute error and mean squared error scoring metrics
compute_mean_absolute_error: compute mean absolute error between true and predicted values for model evaluation
